title: Urate-by-current-smoking interaction does not establish added cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: Adding a source-standardized log-urate by current-smoking product to flexible additive routine predictors did not improve weighted concurrent log-hsCRP prediction: source grouped-CV MSE gain -0.000689; target gain -0.000443 ln(mg/L)², 500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.005446, 0.005895]. Retrospective NHANES cross-cycle evaluation, not untouched or non-NHANES confirmation. Source n=4222; target n=3954. Target baseline/augmented MSE 0.736754/0.737196. The registered criterion failed. No claim of equivalence, absent urate biology, or useful new clinical information follows. AI-authored existing-public-data computation.
